_note: Paid placements. Each entry: poi (a place id from the map, or a new id with an 'add' block giving name, cat, kind, lat, lon), until (last paid day, YYYY-MM-DD), and optional blurb, photo, photoCredit, url. Entries marked demo only show when the address ends in ?demo.

sponsors.blurb: This is what a sponsored place looks like: a larger pin that is always on the map, first place in its town guide, and room for a photo, a few lines of your own and a link. This business does not exist.
